Name: Gaius of Corinth
Role: Host of Paul and of the whole church
Summary: Gaius was Paul's host at Corinth and host of the whole church there; Paul had baptized him, and he sends greetings in Romans 16. He is distinct from the Gaius addressed in 3 John.
KeyStory: Gaius was Paul's host at Corinth and host of the whole church there; Paul had baptized him, and he sends greetings in Romans 16. He is distinct from the Gaius addressed in 3 John.
LifeLesson: Hospitality opens a home and becomes a church; a host's house can hold a whole congregation.
